gloss: truth; the real thing; (prefix) true; genuine

definitions.explanation: Used as a noun for 'the truth' or 'the real essence' of something. Mostly appears in set phrases and formal/literary contexts.
Used as a noun-modifier or prefix meaning 'true' or 'real' — emphasizing that something is the genuine, authentic version. Attaches to many nouns to form compounds.

examples.japanese: {真|しん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追究|ついきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|しん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time to understand the true meaning of his words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真|しん}{犯人|はんにん}→真犯人：28193_shinhannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
{真|しん}{冬|ふゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
examples.english: The cold of midwinter is harsh.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真|しん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{接客|せっきゃく}→接客：12882_sekkyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think the true value of this restaurant lies in its service.

notes:
Highly productive as a prefix; rare as a standalone noun in everyday speech. Sense 1 mostly appears in formal/literary or philosophical contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{真|しん}{実|じつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧: truth (the more common everyday word)
- ⟦{真|しん}{犯人|はんにん}→真犯人：28193_shinhannin⟧: true culprit; real perpetrator
- ⟦{真|しん}{相|そう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧: real state of affairs
- {真|しん}{冬|ふゆ}: midwinter
- {真|しん}{夏|なつ}: midsummer
- {真|しん}{価|か}: true value; real worth

NOTES ON READING:
{真|しん} is the on'yomi reading. The kun'yomi {真|ま} (often written まこと in standalone use) gives a different set of compounds: ⟦{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}→真っ白：07613_masshiro⟧ (pure white), ⟦{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}→真っ暗：07616_makkura⟧ (pitch dark), etc. Context and the following sound usually make the reading clear.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧: truth — the standard everyday noun for 'truth'
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧: real; true; truth — colloquial, very common
- ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧: correct; proper — emphasizes correctness rather than authenticity
